Resume of Howard S. Gorman 
HGorman@HSG-Group.biz Phone (516) 244-6806 
Page 1 
Mr. Gorman has more than 25 years of experience in the energy industry, including 15 years 
in rate and regulatory proceedings, and more than 30 years overall of professional experience in 
accounting, finance and rate and regulatory matters. 
Mr. Gorman has testified as an expert witness on revenue requirements, class cost of service, 
revenue allocation and rate design.  He has testified as an expert witness before the NYS PSC, and 
also before the Massachusetts Department of Public Utilities, New Jersey Board of Public Utilities, 
New Hampshire Public Utilities Commission, Ontario Energy Board, Pennsylvania Public Utility 
Commission and Rhode Island Public Utilities Commission. 
Mr. Gorman also has experience in financial modeling, financial analysis and forecasting, 
developing accounting systems, competitive service, and treasury and financial management.  He is 
a NYS Certified Public Accountant. 
PROFESSIONAL EMPLOYMENT

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Utility Accounting and Costing 
Mr. Gorman has performed numerous class cost of service studies for electric and gas 
utilities, and has also developed and supported revenue requirements, revenue allocation and rate 
designs.  These assignments included development of test year data, establishment of cost causality, 
selection and development of allocators, and analysis of customer impacts and policy considerations. 
Mr. Gorman also has extensive experience in financial accounting.  As controller of Trigen 
Energy Corporation, he founded and built the finance and accounting function; developed reports, 
procedures and management tools; and managed subsidiary controllers across North America, 
including an IPO with NYSE listing. 
Energy Project Analysis 
Mr. Gorman has performed financial analyses of energy-related assets, including electric and 
gas distribution companies, power plants and transmission operators.  These valuations included

Energy Project Financing 
Mr. Gorman has negotiated and completed transactions including construction and term

rates with large volume customers.  I am the regulatory lead for the Company’s 
Temperature Controlled Core Committee.  I also provide support for stakeholder outreach 
with regulatory contacts. 
 
Principal Analyst, Gas Pricing and Manager, Analytical Center of Excellence (“ACE”) – 
NY, National Grid, September 2011 – July 2014 
As process owner, provided interpretation (internally and externally) of the three gas 
companies’ tariffs, as well as ensured compliance of those tariffs.  Developed and filed 
non-firm rates.  I managed five analysts who reside in the ACE.  Ensured that all tariff 
and compliance filings were accurate and timely. 
 
Lead Analyst, Gas Pricing – NY, National Grid, October 2005 – September 2011 
Collaborated with Gas Pricing Manager to develop and implement rate case/merger 
strategies.  This included revenue decoupling which ensures that the Company does not 
experience a reduction in revenue due to successful implementation of energy efficiency 
programs resulting in decreased consumption.  I coordinated with Legal to make certain 
that there was proper documentation of rate case/merger initiatives such as tariffs.  I was 
a member of the Discovery Control Group.  I monitored compliance throughout the 
Company with regards to Joint Proposal 1 (Energy Efficiency), Joint Proposal 2 
(Merger), Joint Proposal 3 (Customer Service), and Joint Proposal 4 (KEDNY & KEDLI 
Rate Plans.  I was the key regulatory participant for the Purchase of Receivable and 
ESCO Referral Program Collaboratives.   
 
Senior Analyst, State and Federal Regulatory Affairs, The Brooklyn Union Gas Company 
d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New York – April 2000 – October 2005 
I was responsible for the development of market-based competitive pricing such as 
Temperature Controlled rates and Natural Gas Vehicle rates.  In addition, monitored 
those competitive fuels’ trends and reported as such.  Partnered with Customer Choice to 
implement the New York State Public Service Commission’s directives regarding the 
unbundling of gas supply.
